deadline.value: Apply by January 4, 2027; no late applications.
deadline.quote: The PhD application and all supporting materials, such as score reports and letters of recommendation, are due January 4, 2027.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is strongly recommended for all applicants; there is no minimum score.
gre_general.quote: We strongly recommend the Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) General Test of all applicants.

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics Subject test is strongly recommended for PhD applicants but not required.
gre_subject.quote: We do not require any GRE subject tests. | We strongly recommend that applicants to the PhD program take the math subject test.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 overall (or 4.5 on the new scale); no section minimums.
toefl_min.quote: The Department of Statistics requires a minimum TOEFL score of 90 overall, and a minimum IELTS scores of 7.0 overall.

also.quote: Our TOEFL minimum is 90 or 4.5. Our IELTS minimum is 7.0. We do not have minimum scores for each subsection.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall; no section minimums.
ielts_min.quote: The Department of Statistics requires a minimum TOEFL score of 90 overall, and a minimum IELTS scores of 7.0 overall.

supervisor.value: You apply to the degree program, not to a professor; naming a professor of interest does not bind you.
supervisor.quote: You are welcome to discuss your interest in a particular specialization or professor in your application, but that does not bind you to pursuing that specialization or working with that professor if you enroll.

funding.value: PhD students generally receive full support covering tuition, fees, health insurance and living expenses, the same for domestic and international students.
funding.quote: Our PhD students generally receive full support, including tuition, fees, health insurance, and living expenses. | Departmental support is the same for domestic and international students.

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed; most PhD students come straight from their bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Do I need to have a MS in order to apply for the PhD program? | No, most of our students come directly from college.

notes: About 80% of students are from outside the US (department FAQ).
